summary: Gigabit Ethernet (RMAC + layer-3 switch, RTL8211 PHY) with lwIP.
readme: Ethernet example: RT-Thread Ethernet + lwIP on the board's ports (RMAC, RTL8211 PHY)
notes: The SDK example sets a static IP address and gateway for its own lab network; the recipe leaves RT-Thread's defaults - set the address for your network (or DHCP) in RT-Thread Settings.
